FLINK-35939.title: [FLINK-35939] Do not set empty config values via ConfigUtils#encodeCollectionToConfig
FLINK-35939.description:
## What is the purpose of the change

Avoid setting empty config values in `ConfigUtils#encodeCollectionToConfig`.  I think this could cause unintentional overwrites and I believe setting an empty collection as a config options in general should mean the same as if that config was not set at all.

Right now this behavior causes to have `pipeline.classpaths` and `pipeline.jars` have an empty list value by default.

## Brief change log

  - Skip setting if the encoded values are empty.
  - Adapt unit tests.


## Verifying this change

This change is a trivial rework / code cleanup without any test coverage.

## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): no
  - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: no
  - The serializers: no
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): no
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: no
  - The S3 file system connector: no

## Documentation

  - Does this pull request introduce a new feature? no
  - If yes, how is the feature documented? not applicable

commits.message: [hotfix] Move BufferDebloatConfiguration's checkState's into constructor
commits.author: Piotr Nowojski

commits.message:
[FLINK-36555] Guarantee buffer grows even with very small alpha

With small buffer sizes and/or small EMA's alpha, previously
it could happen buffer size won't grow at all, because for example:
- current buffer size is 16b
- max new desired size is only capped at 2 * 16b = 32b
- so with alpha ~= 0.03 (or smaller) the new buffer size would be still 16b
commits.author: Piotr Nowojski

commits.message:
[FLINK-36556] Add starting buffer size config option

Starting buffer size of 32KB (previous behaviour) could cause
large amount of in-flight data to accumulate before BufferDebloating
could even kick in. Now this starting size is smaller by default
and is allowed to be configured.
commits.author: Piotr Nowojski

FLINK-36711.title: [FLINK-36711][runtime] Add tips when System out and err are redirected to LOG or discarded
FLINK-36711.description:
## What is the purpose of the change

When System.out and System.err are redirected to LOG or discarded, there are some scenarios that do not match the user's expectations, leading them to be unclear about how to view the relevant output information.
